title: Rodil Zalameda as chief justice: What to expect
summary: Get to know the new Supreme Court chief justice more in this report by Rappler’s Jairo Bolledo

blocks.text: Get to know the new Supreme Court chief justice more in this report by Rappler’s Jairo Bolledo
MANILA, Philippines – Rodil Zalameda rose from the ranks – from prosecutor to the 28th chief justice of the Supreme Court (SC).
He served as an associate justice of both the Court of Appeals and the SC.
Zalameda will serve until his mandatory retirement age of 70 in 2033.
